decisions.label: Cut-away size
decisions.note: How big the circle cut in the canopy round her on the ground is, as a share of the screen's width (Ed, 2026-10-14: "the canopy cut-away radius is too large": two thirds of the old 0.8). Her light's reach is set from it (glowToCutout), so it grows and shrinks with it; at 0.53 her light is as before.
